theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is rank-2 and eligible, with the strongest durability and breadth profile in the entire book: durability_bar 0.85, breadth 1.0, and a 'trend' hurst tag — the cleanest combination of cohesion and trend-health among named themes. It is crowded (z 1.8), which on my guardrails is only a size-down caution, never a fade. Unlike the AI Infrastructure leader, cybersecurity shows uniformly strong breadth rather than a narrow leadership, suggesting the trend is broadly participated rather than single-stock.
theses.dissent: Crowding z of 1.8 is the highest crowding flag in the table; combined with score already fading relative to AI Infrastructure (margin to leader is 0.342 and compressing), this could be a late-stage consensus trade where the broad participation is a contrarian top signal rather than healthy rotation.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is rank-4 and eligible, with a 'trend' hurst tag, solid breadth (0.727), and no crowding (z 0.83). It is one of only two energy-related eligible themes (with equal-weight Energy at rank 6), giving the energy complex a breadth-of-participation signal across both cap-weighted and equal-weight construction. The trend gate is doing its job here: eligible themes with durable trend tags are the staying-power leg, not return forecasters, and energy has both.
evidence: Energy (Equal-Weight) also eligible at rank 6, confirming participation
theses.dissent: Score is only modestly positive (1.005) and value state on the macro side shows 'fading' for the AI complex, not energy; energy is not part of the dominant ai_tech macro narrative, so this is a quiet carry trade with no attention catalyst — it can drift sideways and bleed relative opportunity cost.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 50-day moving average and stays there for two consecutive weeks.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is rank-1 and eligible with positive score (1.98), but its durability_bar (0.68), mixed hurst tag, breadth (0.708), and r10 (0.0088) all point to a theme that is holding its rank on legacy weighting rather than fresh participation. The rotation radar shows it as leader with a narrowing margin to Cybersecurity (0.342) and breath fraction contracting (0.39, 'narrowing'). Weight 0.25 with 0.0 cash in headline also signals the theme is already heavily owned. Crowding is not flagged (z 0.59), but that does not make it a buy — rank is not a return forecast.
evidence: rotation margin to challenger=0.342 and compressing
theses.dissent: AI Infrastructure is still rank-1 with the highest score and eligible=true; the absolute-trend gate has NOT flipped it out, and AI is the only macro narrative the market cares about (dominant_themes contains ai_tech). Avoiding it means standing aside from the trade with the most attention, which can underperform in a momentum continuation regime.

falsifier.text: SMH makes a new 20-day high and its breadth (percent of constituents above 50-day MA) rises above 0.80.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
